component.text: Air-borne spread follows connected room space and does not freely pass through walls. Food-borne and water-borne infection follows food, recipes, potions and drinks. Blood spread follows contaminated blood and needles.

Contact-based strains contaminate blocks that are touched, mined or stepped on. Attack-based strains spread through combat contact. Animal strains can enter livestock and follow their drops. Environmental strains build reservoirs in the world.

Routes interact: airborne plus environmental traits can establish a room reservoir, while persistent contact traits keep surfaces dangerous. Masks reduce incoming air risk and block outgoing air spread; gloves block outgoing contact spread.
